data.name: Connection_Description
data.value: Choose how to connect to the remote NVDA: directly by IP address, or through the public relay server using the channel key.

data.name: Connection_UseRelay_Hint
data.value: When enabled, connects to the public server instead of a direct address.

data.name: Connection_Insecure_Hint
data.value: Only enable for self-hosted direct connections with a self-signed certificate. You will confirm the certificate's identity on first connection.

data.name: Connection_Connect_Hint
data.value: Starts the connection to the remote NVDA using the information entered.

data.name: Connection_Disconnect_Hint
data.value: Ends the current connection or cancels the ongoing reconnection attempt.

data.name: RemoteControl_Description
data.value: Send keys to the remote NVDA and hear the speech received.

data.name: RemoteControl_SendSas_Hint
data.value: Sends the Ctrl+Alt+Del security sequence to the remote machine.

data.name: RemoteControl_ReleaseAll_Hint
data.value: Releases stuck Ctrl, Alt, Shift and Windows keys without triggering any action.

data.name: RemoteControl_SendClipboard_Hint
data.value: Sends the text copied on this phone to the remote machine's clipboard.

data.name: RemoteControl_Disconnect_Hint
data.value: Ends the connection with the remote NVDA.

data.name: Settings_Description
data.value: Adjust the virtual keyboard's NVDA key and manage trusted certificates.

data.name: Settings_TrustedCertificates_Hint
data.value: View and remove certificates accepted in insecure-mode connections.

data.name: Settings_ShareLogs_Description
data.value: Share the current session's technical log to help diagnose a problem. The file does not contain the channel key, and is only sent if you pick a destination.

data.name: Settings_ShareLogs_Hint
data.value: Exports the current session's technical log to share.

data.name: Settings_ShareLogs_Empty
data.value: No logs have been recorded in this session yet.

data.name: TrustedCertificates_Description
data.value: Certificates manually accepted in insecure-mode (TOFU) connections. Remove a certificate to require confirmation again on the next connection to that host.

data.name: CertificateTrust_Message
